description: This Dart source file defines UI widgets and theming for a Flutter web frontend, including theme setup, a scaffold with app bar and sidebar, buttons, and views for loading and error states.

classes.name: AppScaffold
classes.description: A reusable scaffold widget providing an app bar, optional sidebar, and main content area, with session-aware actions.

classes.name: _Sidebar
classes.description: Private widget implementing the sidebar navigation drawer with route links.

classes.name: PrimaryButton
classes.description: A styled button widget used across the app.

classes.name: LoadingView
classes.description: A widget displaying a circular progress indicator and a loading message.

classes.name: ErrorView
classes.description: A widget displaying an error icon, message, and optional retry button.

methods.name: appTheme
methods.description: Defines the application's light theme using Material 3 styling and custom color scheme.

methods.name: AppScaffold.build
methods.description: Builds the main UI structure with navigation bar, optional sidebar, and content area.

methods.name: _Sidebar.build
methods.description: Constructs the navigation drawer with links to various app routes.

methods.name: _navTile
methods.description: Helper method to create navigation list tiles with route handling.

methods.name: PrimaryButton.build
methods.description: Builds a filled button with label and action.

methods.name: LoadingView.build
methods.description: Builds a centered loading indicator with message.

methods.name: ErrorView.build
methods.description: Builds a centered error message with icon and optional retry button.
